execution_log.summary: Opus worker, supervisor review against the live tree. tutil.sh (374 lines): guard, locale, class TUtil per PLAN §1.2; Create assigns every var (cmd, crlf=0, nul=0, _lastRc=-1) and creates ${inst}_args/${inst}_argv with declare -ga, ctor args verbatim (--format=%H, words with spaces); Destroy unsets both arrays; buildArgv (virtual, cmd empty -> kk._return '' + rc 2); addArg/clearArgs; argv NAME (tutil._badOut = kk._outName NAME __tu_ __tg_ + the three instance arrays, rc 2 before any nameref; COPY of the built argv; runs nothing); run (kk.call_silent buildArgv -> command -v pre-check -> "${argv[@]}" || rc=$? -> per-instance _lastRc -> kk.call_silent mapRc -> return RESULT); mapRc base (0->0, 127->1 + debug, else 1 silent); lastRc; the five sinks are stubs (funcs answer __TUTIL_PENDING__ through kk._return, rc 2 + debug). No $this. call anywhere. Red-first against the all-stub skeleton: 47 FAIL of 59. Green: 59/59 on 5.2.37 AND 5.3.9, threaded and --mode single. Reviewer probes on both bashes: $(u.run), od -c < <(u.run) and u.run | od -c byte-identical to the bare tool with -n / a space / a backslash (no leaked kk._return digits); missing cmd rc 1 + lastRc 127 + exactly one debug line; exit 3 -> rc 1 + lastRc 3 silent; two instances keep separate _lastRc; bad out-name rc 2 RESULT ''; delete removes the arrays. Worker deviations accepted: one helper tutil._badOut with rc 0 = refused polarity; func stubs also emit a debug line; argv propagates buildArgv's rc; section G of 001 asserts the stubs (P1 deletes it). Worker fact recorded in PLAN §6: a plain var read at a call site PRINTS and leaves RESULT empty — $(u.crlf) is the only correct read spelling outside a member. Master sweep: 22/22 suites 0 [FAIL] on 5.2.37 and 5.3.9. Committed as kcl 8771cab.

PLAN.md + this ledger written after the owner accepted the TPipe/TUtil/TGrep design. TUtil is concrete (generic argv runner, TProcess kinship), buildArgv/mapRc virtual, three per-instance arrays freed by the destructor, all sinks delegate to TPipe. TGrep argv shape pinned (grep [flags] -e PATTERN [extras] -- PATH...), no -P/--color/context. §7 template for tsed/tawk/tfind/thead/ttail. No code.

Opus critic, 23 probe scripts on both bashes (scratchpad critic_tutil/; base.sh/derived.sh = faithful TUtil/TGrep per the draft). BLOCKERS: (1) `$this.func` inside a member prints the callee's kk._return under $( )/|/<( ) — run leaked '2…0' into its stream; fix = kk.call_silent for every internal member call. (2) `inherited` in a constructor is rewritten to `parent.constructor "$@"` (kklass_pascal.sh:166) — TGrep paths doubled; fix = explicit `parent.constructor grep`. (3) an unassigned `var` is an unbound variable under set -u (kklass.sh:363) and .new over a live instance keeps stale _data; fix = constructor assigns every var. (4) G8 and the flagship example contradicted (grep DIR without -r = rc 2, zero records); fix = `search` implies -r and requires ≥1 path, instances never imply -r. (5) `RESULT=n; return 1` in a func loses RESULT (explicit return skips the trailer, kk._invoke restores the caller's); fix = `kk._return n; return m` ordering. MAJORS: `(` is literal under BRE (G6 needs -E); plain `ln -s` makes a directory copy on this box → kt_make_symlink; grep/sed/gawk strip CR in text mode (crlf is a no-op for them) → `binary` (-U) var; a test's own EXIT trap replaces ktests' trap → framework fixtures; -Z is NUL termination only with -l/-L and a var cannot set `nul` → derived -0; grep rc 2 with partial hits and 'Binary file X matches' on stdout → named deviation + escape hatch; bare "${argv[@]}" aborts a set -e caller → `|| rc=$?`; fixed throw-away name clobbered by nested search → BASHPID+seq; non-GNU grep on PATH (Embarcadero) → GNU banner gate; missing cmd prints bash's own unconditional stderr → `command -v` pre-check. MINOR/NIT: var-vs-inherited-method same name (method wins silently) → reserved names; kk.isInt accepts negatives and the OUTVAR form writes through the property nameref → $__KK_INT and >= 0; -h/-H and -l/-L pairs rc 2; empty pattern rc 2; sed `--` asymmetry explained; TStringList.Add may answer rc 1 (TPipe guards it); out-name helper status converted to 2; func stubs must kk._return a sentinel. 18 claims verified correct and listed in PLAN §8.
